mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS net_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.sett_amount, 0) + COALESCE(o.service_fee, 0)), 0) AS gross_before_discount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.discount_amount, 0)), 0) AS discount_total, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0)), 0) AS refund_total, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.number_of_diners, 0)), 0) AS diner_sum_all, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.dineInOrTakeOut = '堂食' THEN COALESCE(o.number_of_diners, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS diner_sum_dine_in, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.dineInOrTakeOut = '堂食' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dine_in_order_count FROM t_order o WHERE

SELECT slot_key AS slot_key, COALESCE(SUM(amt), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIME(o.order_time) >= '05:00:00' AND TIME(o.order_time) < '10:00:00' THEN 'breakfast' WHEN TIME(o.order_time) >= '10:00:00' AND TIME(o.order_time) < '16:00:00' THEN 'lunch' WHEN TIME(o.order_time) >= '16:00:00' AND TIME(o.order_time) < '22:00:00' THEN 'dinner' ELSE 'late_night' END AS slot_key, AS amt FROM t_order o WHERE
) x GROUP BY slot_key

SELECT slot_key AS slot_key, COALESCE(SUM(amt), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIME(o.order_time) >= '16:00:00' AND TIME(o.order_time) < '22:00:00' THEN 'bd_evening' WHEN TIME(o.order_time) >= '22:00:00' OR TIME(o.order_time) < '04:00:00' THEN 'bd_late_night' WHEN TIME(o.order_time) >= '04:00:00' AND TIME(o.order_time) < '10:00:00' THEN 'bd_breakfast' ELSE 'bd_lunch' END AS slot_key, AS amt FROM t_order o WHERE
) x GROUP BY slot_key

SELECT LPAD(hh, 2, '0') AS hour_key, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT HOUR(o.order_time) AS hh, AS net_revenue FROM t_order o WHERE
) x GROUP BY hh ORDER BY hour_key ASC

SELECT CONCAT('bd_hour_', LPAD(bd_hour, 2, '0')) AS hour_key, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT ((HOUR(o.order_time) + 24 - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{openTime}, ':', 1) AS UNSIGNED)) % 24) AS bd_hour, AS net_revenue FROM t_order o WHERE
) x GROUP BY bd_hour ORDER BY hour_key ASC

SELECT ch AS channel_key, COALESCE(SUM(amt), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN o.payment_method LIKE '%微信%' THEN 'wechat' WHEN o.payment_method LIKE '%支付宝%' OR LOWER(IFNULL(o.payment_method,'')) LIKE '%alipay%' THEN 'alipay' WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(o.payment_method,'')) = 'cash' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%现金%' THEN 'cash' WHEN o.payment_method LIKE '%余额%' OR IFNULL(o.transaction_id,'') LIKE 'BAL_%' THEN 'member_balance' ELSE 'other' END AS ch, AS amt FROM t_order o WHERE
) t GROUP BY ch

SELECT bucket_label AS bucket_label, COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT o.id, AS net,
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(o.order_time, '%x'), '-W', DATE_FORMAT(o.order_time, '%v')) AS bucket_label
DATE_FORMAT(o.order_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS bucket_label
CAST(YEAR(o.order_time) AS CHAR) AS bucket_label
DATE_FORMAT(o.order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket_label
FROM t_order o WHERE
) z GROUP BY bucket_label ORDER BY bucket_label ASC

SELECT bucket_label AS bucket_label, COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ( SELECT y.id, y.net,
CONCAT(YEAR(y.bd), '-W', LPAD(WEEK(y.bd, 3), 2, '0')) AS bucket_label
DATE_FORMAT(y.bd, '%Y-%m-01') AS bucket_label
CAST(YEAR(y.bd) AS CHAR) AS bucket_label
DATE_FORMAT(y.bd, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket_label
FROM ( SELECT o.id, AS net, AS bd FROM t_order o WHERE
) y ) z GROUP BY bucket_label ORDER BY bucket_label ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.bd) FROM ( SELECT AS bd FROM t_order o WHERE
) x

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN od.name LIKE '%套餐%' OR IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%套餐%' THEN od.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS combo_sales, COALESCE(SUM(od.total_price), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN od.name LIKE '%套餐%' OR IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%套餐%' THEN CAST(od.quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS combo_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(od.quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))), 0) AS total_qty FROM t_order_detail od INNER JOIN t_order o ON od.mId = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time < #{endTime} AND ( (od.total_price IS NOT NULL AND od.total_price > 0) OR IFNULL(od.line_type,'') = 'combo_component' ) AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL)
AND o.shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fp.first_order_time >= #{startTime} AND fp.first_order_time <= #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN fp.first_order_time < #{startTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_customers, COUNT(*) AS distinct_buyers FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT o.openid FROM t_order o WHERE
AND o.openid IS NOT NULL AND o.openid != '' ) pb INNER JOIN ( SELECT openid, MIN(order_time) AS first_order_time FROM t_order WHERE merchantId = '1' AND transac_status = 'success' AND (order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR order_receiving IS NULL) AND openid IS NOT NULL AND openid != '' GROUP BY openid ) fp ON fp.openid = pb.openid

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buyers, SUM(CASE WHEN c >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repurchased_buyers FROM ( SELECT o.openid, COUNT(*) AS c FROM t_order o WHERE
AND o.openid IS NOT NULL AND o.openid != '' GROUP BY o.openid ) t

SELECT bucket_label AS bucket_label, COUNT(*) AS buyer_count FROM ( SELECT o.openid, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '1' WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 THEN '2' WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5' WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket_label FROM t_order o WHERE
AND o.openid IS NOT NULL AND o.openid != '' GROUP BY o.openid ) x GROUP BY bucket_label

SELECT hint_key AS hint_key, SUM(cnt) AS mention_count FROM ( SELECT '忌口' AS hint_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_order_detail od INNER JOIN t_order o ON od.mId = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time < #{endTime} AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL) AND (IFNULL(o.remark,'') LIKE '%忌口%' OR IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%忌口%') AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} UNION ALL SELECT '不吃/不要', COUNT(*) FROM t_order_detail od INNER JOIN t_order o ON od.mId = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time < #{endTime} AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL) AND (IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%不吃%' OR IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%不要%') AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} UNION ALL SELECT '过敏', COUNT(*) FROM t_order_detail od INNER JOIN t_order o ON od.mId = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time < #{endTime} AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL) AND IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%过敏%' AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} UNION ALL SELECT '免辣/不辣', COUNT(*) FROM t_order_detail od INNER JOIN t_order o ON od.mId = o.id WHERE o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time < #{endTime} AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL) AND (IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%免辣%' OR IFNULL(od.remark,'') LIKE '%不辣%') AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} ) u GROUP BY hint_key

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.user_type = 1 THEN net ELSE 0 END), 0) AS member_net_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) AS total_net_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN u.user_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_order_rows, COUNT(*) AS order_rows FROM ( SELECT o.id, o.openid, AS net FROM t_order o WHERE
) x LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.openid = x.openid
